items.item: S7 authority: the requester decides business scope; every other scope is blocked until a binding names someone; the authority file is validated strictly; the policy hash is order-independent
tests: S7 the requester decides business scope by default; every other scope is blocked until a binding names someone
authority file: absent means no bindings; malformed or unknown content is rejected, not ignored
the policy hash changes when a binding changes and not when its order does

a waiver needs criteria, residual risk and a future expiry, and policy authority
